data.title: Watcher in the Dark (Once per battle, per unit)
data.text: Watcher in the Dark (Once per battle, per unit): In any phase, when this unit suffers a mortal wound, this unit can summon a Watcher in the Dark. If it does, this unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

data.title: Knights of Caliban
data.text: Knights of Caliban: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s melee attacks have [ANTI-MONSTER/VEHICLE 4+].

data.title: Engulfing Fear (psychic level 1)
data.text:
Engulfing Fear (psychic level 1): In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- Select one enemy unit within 12" of this model. That unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

data.title: Teleport Homer (Once per battle, per unit)
data.text:
Teleport Homer (Once per battle, per unit): At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do:
- When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit. That Teleport Homer token is then removed from the battlefield.
- If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that Teleport Homer token, that Teleport Homer token is removed from the battlefield.

data.title: Icon of Old Caliban
data.text: Icon of Old Caliban: While a friendly DARK ANGELS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit has Stealth.

data.title: Primarch of the First Legion
data.text: Primarch of the First Legion: At the start of your Command phase, you can select up to two of the abilities in the Primarch of the First Legion section. Until the start of your next Command phase, this model has those abilities.

data.title: Chief Librarian (psyker level 3)
data.text: Chief Librarian (psyker level 3): This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.

data.title: Feared Interrogator
data.text: Feared Interrogator: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy CHARACTER unit within 6" of this model makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

data.title: Master Strategist
data.text: Master Strategist: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to any other combat doctrine.

data.title: The Emperor's Shield
data.text: The Emperor's Shield: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

data.title: Deathwing
data.text:
Deathwing: This unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to:
- BS and WS.
- Hit rolls.

data.title: Exemplar of Hate
data.text: Exemplar of Hate: This unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

data.title: Astartes Banner
data.text: Astartes Banner: While this unit contains a RAVENWING ANCIENT, this unit has +1 OC.

data.title: Martial Exemplar
data.text:
Martial Exemplar: While a friendly DARK ANGELS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s melee attacks can:
- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

data.title: The Watchers
data.text: The Watchers: This unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

data.title: Book of Salvation
data.text: Book of Salvation: This unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

data.title: Strikes of Retribution
data.text:
Strikes of Retribution: In the fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
- On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield.

data.title: Storm of Vengeance (Once per turn, per unit)
data.text: Storm of Vengeance (Once per turn, per unit): In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit shoots using normal shooting but while doing so this unit can only target that enemy unit.

data.title: Honour or Death
data.text:
Honour or Death: While this unit contains a Ravenwing Champion:
- This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.
- When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.

data.title: Cut Off Their Escape
data.text: Cut Off Their Escape: When an enemy unit engaged with this unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) makes a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is battle-shocked, -1 from those hazard rolls.

data.title: Watcher in the Dark
data.text:
Watcher in the Dark: Once per battle, in any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model in this unit, this unit can summon a Watcher in the Dark. When it does, until the end of the phase, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Designer’s Note: Place a Watcher in the Dark token next to the unit, removing it when this ability has been used.

data.title: Stasis Bomb
data.text:
Stasis Bomb: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, select one visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT/Lone Operative units) within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit is slowed until the end of your opponent’s next Movement phase:
- While a unit is slowed, in your opponent’s Movement phase, when that unit is selected to move, unless that unit remains stationary, roll one D6:
- On a 1-4, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and that unit has -2" M.
- On a 5-6, that unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and that unit has -3" M.
